'''2017 MPC Jeffrey Johns LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jeffrey Johns]] at [[2017 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jeffrey Johns]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 Match Play Championship]]
